async def act(page):
    # Click the 'Issues' link in the project navigation to go to the issues page
    issues_link = page.get_by_role('complementary', name='Project navigation').get_by_role('link', name='Issues')
    await issues_link.click()
    # Wait for navigation to complete
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Wait a bit more for dynamic content to load
    await asyncio.sleep(3)
    # Since no API functions are available, retrieve the text content of the page that lists issues
    # Use a broad selector to get the main content area where issues are likely displayed
    # Assuming issues are in the main role or a specific container; if not, fall back to body
    try:
        issues_container = page.get_by_role('main')
        issues_text = await issues_container.inner_text()
    except:
        # If main role not found, get the entire page body text
        issues_text = await page.inner_text('body')
    # Return the text as the result; this is raw without processing
    return issues_text
